# Manual acceptance checks

1. App opens offline and canon seed registers once.
2. Paste a conversation -> registry count increases; concepts and mesh edges appear.
3. Import a text file through Android Files/Drive -> file registers with Drive provenance.
4. Research query -> local RAG returns matching canon and imports.
5. With internet -> arXiv and PubMed evidence packets appear.
6. Repeating concept mining over identical text must not duplicate identical Klein edge IDs for the same context.
7. AutoNovel report explicitly distinguishes direct evidence from synthesis.
8. Coder output labels itself proposal-only and contains preservation/provenance/Klein tests.
9. Saving report opens Android document save picker.
